cuisine.title: Fresh produce, cooked just right
cuisine.text: It all starts with the produce: fish, good meat, seasonal vegetables. In the kitchen we take the time to cook things properly, which is what keeps regulars coming back. The menu is French, with a nod to Portugal, like bacalhau à brás.

items.a: We serve lunch: Monday to Friday from 12 pm to 2:30 pm, and Sunday from 12:30 pm to 3 pm. The restaurant is closed on Saturdays.
It's a good idea, especially for Sunday lunch and tables of more than six. Book online or call +33 3 22 95 04 44.

items.q: Is the seafood platter served every day?
items.a: It depends on the catch. The safest is to ask for it when you book: we'll have it ready for you.
Yes. The dining room seats 70. Birthdays, communions, christenings, company meals: we plan a menu with you, with a quote.
Yes, on request: bacalhau à brás and other specialities. Just let us know when you book.
Card and cash. For meal vouchers (titres-restaurant), ask us when you book.

dury.title: Restaurant in Dury
dury.metaTitle: Restaurant in Dury, just south of Amiens | L'Estrella
dury.metaDescription: A restaurant in Dury on route Nationale, 10 minutes from Amiens: weekday lunch, Sunday lunch, family meals. Parking, 70 covers.
dury.lead: At 103 route Nationale, L'Estrella serves lunch Monday to Friday and on Sundays. Easy to find from Amiens, with somewhere to park.

sections.p: Dury is less than 10 km from central Amiens along route Nationale. For a quiet lunch break away from city-centre parking, the board changes every week: a starter, a main, a dessert.
On Sundays the dining room fills with families. White tablecloths, dishes to share, a seafood platter for those who ordered one: book ahead to be sure of your table.
With 70 covers, L'Estrella hosts birthdays, communions, christenings and company meals. We plan the menu with you.

seafood.title: Seafood near Amiens
seafood.metaTitle: Seafood platter near Amiens, in Dury | L'Estrella
seafood.metaDescription: A seafood platter to share in Dury, 10 minutes from Amiens: oysters, prawns, whelks depending on the catch. Ask when you book, perfect for Sunday lunch.
seafood.lead: In Dury, 10 minutes from Amiens, L'Estrella prepares a seafood platter to share, depending on the catch. The best way to enjoy it: ask for it when you book.

sections.p: Oysters, prawns, whelks and the best of the day's catch. Served on ice, with rye bread, salted butter, lemon and homemade mayonnaise. We'll give you the exact selection when you book.
The platter is prepared in advance. Mention it in your booking, or call us on +33 3 22 95 04 44: we'll confirm the selection and the day's price.
Scallop risotto with crayfish, fried cod steak, bacalhau à brás: fish has pride of place on the menu and on the board.
